summary.en-US: Delayed media playback companion for sleep

description.en-US:
AfterSleep is a privacy-friendly Android app that lets users delay media playback until after they fall asleep.

Instead of starting music, podcasts, audiobooks, or videos immediately, AfterSleep can pause active playback and automatically resume it later after a configurable delay.

The app works with Android media sessions and supports many media apps.

Features:

* Delayed playback start
* Optional automatic stop timer
* Foreground service reliability
* AMOLED-friendly dark interface
* Offline operation
* No ads
* No tracking
* No account required

AfterSleep is designed as a calm and minimal sleep companion focused on reliability and privacy.

summary.en-US: Remove SponsorBlock segments from local video and audio files

description.en-US:
SBSkip is a SponsorBlock-powered media cleaner for Android.

Select a local video or audio file, provide the corresponding YouTube URL,
and SBSkip will retrieve SponsorBlock segments and create a cleaned copy
with sponsor segments removed.

Features:

* SponsorBlock integration
* Local video and audio file processing
* Background processing with WorkManager
* Material 3 user interface
* Persistent settings with DataStore
* FFmpeg-based media trimming
* No account required

SBSkip processes media locally on the device. No YouTube account or API key
is required.
